heroHeadline: Nature Biotechnology Precision mRNA Targeting Breakthrough; EU Approves Next-Gen Moderna Vaccines
heroSubtitle: Mount Sinai researchers published a Nature Biotechnology paper (Apr 29) on technology controlling which immune cells express mRNA vaccines — enabling enhanced cancer immunity and potential autoimmune suppression. Moderna Q1 2026 beat estimates ($400M revenue) with EU approvals for next-gen COVID vaccine mNEXSPIKE (refrigerator storage) and first-ever flu+COVID combo mRNA vaccine mCOMBRIAX. BioNTech Q1 results featured a $1B buyback and BNT116 showing 45% response rate in lung cancer Phase 1. Meanwhile, the FDA announced a VRBPAC meeting for May 28 to select the 2026–2027 COVID vaccine strain, as reports emerged that the FDA blocked publication of completed mRNA vaccine safety studies under the current US administration.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA, EMA, WHO, NIH, peer-reviewed publications (NEJM, Science, Nature, Nature Biotechnology), Q1 2026 company earnings, and AACR 2026 presentations. Timeline covers 2020-12-11 to present.
